The past copula thī is explicitly included under sthita in Turner, distinct from present hai; the first two components are bubhukṣā and lagyati. Local unaspirated tī and participial t remain in the source form; progressive r-clauses are excluded.

proposals.evidence: The full predicate is thirst + be felt + was. Turner tṛṣā documents tis and taras/tareh; lagyati supplies lag-, and sthita explicitly supplies the thī past copula. All three components are represented in their original order.
